_metadata.description: Switch the preview iframe's theme between built-in themes and themes derived from a target scenario's DESIGN.md.

requirements.title: Built-in themes are seeded into the registry and selectable from the UI
requirements.description: `builtin_themes` (id, name, tokens_json) is seeded at boot with at least: vrooli-default, neutral-light, neutral-dark, high-contrast. `GET /api/v1/themes/builtin` lists them; `GET /api/v1/themes/builtin/{id}` returns tokens.

validation.notes: Repository test asserts seed-on-empty behavior; handler tests cover list/get.

requirements.title: Target scenario's DESIGN.md is resolved server-side to normalized JSON
requirements.description: `GET /api/v1/themes/from-scenario/{scenario_id}` reads the named scenario's `DESIGN.md` via the storage resolver, parses the YAML front-matter using the canonical `vrooli-default` schema (colors, typography, rounded, spacing, components), and returns normalized JSON. Unknown shapes reject with HTTP 422 and a structured error. The client never builds the URL or parses DESIGN.md directly.

validation.notes: Service test feeds the flow-verifier DESIGN.md and asserts the normalized JSON shape; negative test for a malformed front-matter returns 422.

requirements.title: Preview harness mounts the selected theme as CSS custom properties before render
requirements.description: When a theme is selected, the host posts the normalized tokens via the bridge. The harness child applies them as CSS custom properties on `:root` before mounting the component, then triggers a re-render.

validation.notes: BAS flow `theme-switch-applies` confirms the preview reflects the theme change.
